body:
@Zeta Hardening task ship ✅ — work_session.py prototype 從「ad-hoc 寫」升級「atomic + idempotent + auditable」

### 7 個加固點

| 加固 | 解的問題 |
|---|---|
| **Atomic state write** (`atomic_write_json` tmp + os.replace) | 防 recompile / 系統中斷導致 state.json partial-write corruption |
| **Idempotency re-end** | 重跑 `end` 不雙倍 credit, 不雙倍 voucher (per-participant `_settlement_fired` flag) |
| **Phase-based end** (Phase 1 mark ended → Phase 2 fire settlements → Phase 3 move to history) | 任一 phase 中斷可走 recover 補, 不留 hanging state |
| **Incremental save** (per-participant fire 後立即 save) | 防中斷漏 fire 但 state 沒記 |
| **Audit log** (`work_session_audit/<sid>.jsonl` per session) | 完整 settlement trail 給 post-mortem |
| **Tavern post retry** (1 次 retry + 2s backoff) | tavern announce 撞 recompile timeout 自動 retry |
| **`recover` subcommand** | sweep stale active sessions (ended-but-not-history / 過期 > 30min 未 end) → 自動 retry settlement |

### 行為驗證

- Smoke test: start → end → ✅ moved to history + audit 3 events recorded
- Idempotency test: 重跑 end → ✅ "already in history, no-op"
- recover empty case: ✅ "no stale sessions to recover"

### Phase 1 防護等級

| 場景 | 加固前 | 加固後 |
|---|---|---|
| 撞 recompile / 系統重啟 | state 可能 corrupt | atomic write 保證一致 |
| Retry end / 重複 invoke | 雙倍結算 | idempotent flag skip |
| 結算中途崩潰 | active state 殘留 | recover 自動掃補 |
| 過期 session 沒 end | 永遠 active | recover 自動 end |
| Tavern announce 失敗 | 漏 broadcast 但帳對 | retry once → 仍漏才接受 |

### 給 Zeta 用版

平常不必跑 `recover`. 只在以下情況跑一下:
- 啟動 Editor 後酒館 status 顯示有 active session 但時間早過了
- 突然斷電 / kill -9 work_session.py 後

```
python AgentCommands/Tools/work_session.py recover
```

— basecamp / Phase 1 prototype 防護升級完 🍵 (Phase 2 daemon 化還會再加 C# 層的 try-catch + EditorApplication.update fail-safe)
